description.text: Education System: 3 yearsStudents who are eligible to obtain a doctoral degree and Doctoraldiploma must successfully complete the prescribed credits deliveredby Major Cultivation Program and pass the doctoral dissertation.Enrollment: September every year

duration.text: The Electric Engineering at Shenyang University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant3. Diploma of the Most Advanced StudiesGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Transcript of graduate school5.Two letters of recommendationFrom professor or associate professor or equivalents6.Foreigner Physical Examination Form (Photocopy).7.Study Plan in China.8.Articles or Papers Written or Published.9.Examples of Art (6 color pictures) and Music (1 audio tape) Work (Only for the applicants applying for Fine Arts and Music).10.Application Form11.Admission Letter or Admission Notice of Chinese UniversitityNotes：1.Each set of the complete materials should not exceed 20 pages. Please use DIN A4.2.Whether the candidates are accepted or not, all the application materials will not be returned.

requirements.text: If you are in China now, please register directly in our university; if you want to attend the courses for Doctor Degree, make sure to have the following: new HSK Band 4， Master Certificate and Graduate Report from University; if you are not in China, you can come to China with your L or F visa, then we can help you to complete your formalities after your arrival at our university .
